item.title: Academic Success Retreat, Hosted by Student Success Center
item.description: Hosted by the Student Success Center on Sunday, August 30, from 1:00–5:30 p.m. in DCC 318, this retreat is open to all students. The retreat is designed to help students rebuild their academic self-efficacy and confidence so they can proactively shape and rewrite their educational trajectory. Presentations are intentionally designed to help students identify specific obstacles impacting their academic performance while recognizing their personal strengths and connecting with campus support…

item.title: Last Day to Make Meal Plan Changes - September 1st
item.description: Please note that students may increase or decrease the size of their residential dining plan up until September 1st. After this, only dining plan increases will be allowed. Note that students are allowed a TOTAL of two plan changes per semester. To make these changes please email dining@rpi.edu and include your full name, RIN and meal plan you currently have and meal plan you want to change to.

item.title: Interested in Business? Clubs, Connections, and Ice Cream Sandwiches!
item.description: Looking for a new way to get involved and learn about business at RPI? Stop by Lally Club Day on September 2 at 2:00 p.m. in the Pittsburgh Building! Any background welcome. Meet student clubs, discover new interests, and connect with peers. Plus, challenge new friends in Mario Kart and enjoy ice cream sandwiches and popcorn!

item.title: Paris Syndrome | Miho Hatori
item.description: Date: Friday, September 4, 2026 9:00 PM - Following the success of her multimedia project Salon Mondialité, musician and artist Miho Hatori returns with the world premiere of Paris Syndrome, an EMPAC-commissioned performance created with Michiko Ogawa (shô) and Dan Peck (tuba). Surrounded by shifting fields of live sound, voice, and image, join us and encounter what happens when perception begins to slip. One show only. Included with festival pass.

item.title: Faculty Meet & Greet
item.description: The Student Success Center invites faculty to a Meet & Greet on Wednesday, Sept. 2nd from 9am -11am at the Success Center, First Floor of the Folsom Library. Stop by for coffee and light refreshments, connect with our team, and enjoy brief tour of our space. We’ll introduce you to the resources and services available to support you and your students through the upcoming fall semester.

item.title: Leadercamp: The 12 Lifetraps Hindering Your Impact
item.description:
Discover the hidden patterns that can limit confidence, relationships, decision-making, and leadership effectiveness. In this Leadercamp, participants will explore the lifetraps that quietly shape behavior and learn how to recognize when old patterns are getting in the way of present-day impact. The session will offer practical tools for increasing self-awareness, breaking unhelpful cycles, and leading with greater clarity and intention.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
